parameters.name: DatabaseName
parameters.description: The name of the database. This parameter supports only exact matches.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20. If you do not specify this parameter, 20 entries are returned.
> Specify a value for this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the database. Valid values:

- **Local**: a local database

- **Rds**: an ApsaraDB RDS database

- **PolarDB**: a PolarDB database

parameters.name: SourceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the source instance. This parameter supports only exact matches.

parameters.name: SourceInstanceState
parameters.description:
The status of the source instance. You can use this parameter to filter the results.

- **Normal**: The instance is running.

- **RemoteRelease**: The instance is released.
